mentions.name: Scored workout tracker (aft.jodavaho.io)
mentions.description: This app is a workout tracker for logging only standard, scored workout sessions. Each logged workout produces a score to improve (or degrade) on, and progress is publicly viewable, giving the score-based and public accountability the builder needs to stay consistent at the gym. It is free and publicly available.
mentions.problem: The builder tends to fall off the workout wagon without public accountability and without scores to improve on, which makes gym trips feel diluted to the point of ennui.
mentions.audience: The author themself, described as an n=1 user who needs accountability to keep working out.
mentions.source_excerpt: Nothing to special, but I made a workout tracker that allows me to only log a standard, scored workout.

evidence.value: Nothing to special, but I made a workout tracker that allows me to only log a standard, scored workout.
